description: Under OpenTarget, once the designated first participant completes, the responder may see only the primary comparison metric of that result before starting their own attempt - no other metric.
notes: The Backend has no OpenTarget concept and no issuance-order gating at all today (either participant may StartAttempt/CompleteAttempt for the current game in any order). This fixture is the spec #9 (frozen InformationPolicy + first-attempt ordering)/#10 (challenge-time policy selection)/#11 (issuance gating + partial-target projection) must satisfy; it mirrors Unity's SeriesSnapshot.FirstAttemptParticipantIndex + VersusGame.CanIssueTo + VersusGame.ViewFor exactly.
